name: M_f5_logit_q0.8_l0.5
code: scripts/rc_predict.py: market_features, market_models (target f5, model logit), flag_of(p, 0.8)
target: sum of the tradable equal-weight market return over label rows t..t+4 < -5%
model: SimpleImputer(median) + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000); expanding window from day 60, refit every 20 days from day 500; a training row s needs s <= t-7
use: prob > expanding 80% quantile of its own past predictions (>= 120 obs, lagged one day) -> exposure 0.5; held 3 more days after the condition clears
how_to_read: rc_prepare.py --end <last day> --out runs/_risk_track --skip-families ; rc_predict.py --dir runs/_risk_track --track  -> runs/_risk_track/track_M.json (also checks that the overlap reproduces runs/_risk/risk_control_p2.json)
verdict_rule: after >= 250 new trading days containing >= 5 fall episodes: fwd5 after a flag below fwd5 otherwise AND Sharpe of half-on-flag equal-weight market above fully invested; otherwise rejected
in_sample_record: out-of-sample 2023-08-08..2026-09-16 (already seen, not evidence): Sharpe 1.32/1.34 vs 0.99/1.01; the whole gain is 2024-01/02
